description: 1. Agent reads `.claude/project-context.md` to discover: (a) audience is 68% mobile → needs mobile-optimised input, (b) lead magnet is '7-Day Executive Mindfulness Starter Kit', (c) an existing inline referral form is on the page → agent must NOT choose inline placement, (d) GDPR/CCPA compliance is mandatory, (e) double opt-in is required by policy. 2. Agent creates `newsletter-signup.html` with: a proper `<form>` element, a single `<input type='email'>` (not type='text'), a `<label>` element with a `for` attribute matching the input's `id` (not relying on placeholder alone as label), a submit `<button type='submit'>` styled with at least 44×44px touch targets. 3. Agent incorporates the lead magnet value proposition text referencing the Mindfulness Starter Kit. 4. Agent includes a privacy policy link/reference (GDPR/CCPA). 5. Agent mentions double opt-in / confirmation email in the copy. 6. Agent places the form as a popup, modal, sticky header, or similar non-inline placement to avoid competing with the existing inline referral form. The primary traps: (a) using placeholder instead of proper <label for/id>, (b) forgetting type='email', (c) ignoring the existing inline form and creating another inline form, (d) not reading project-context.md and missing the lead magnet details.
